This pattern strongly suggests **Die_Back** (complete shoot/leaf death). Let me confirm with one reference image.

The Die_Back reference matches almost exactly: same uniform dark brown coloration, same elongated curled/desiccated form, same complete tissue death with no green remaining, same white background. The morphology and symptom pattern are a near-identical match.
